current.text: He comes into this season with a more defined role in Boston.

One expert projects him as a bench player. In this projection the starters are Derrick White, Baylor Scheierman, Jayson Tatum, Paul George and Neemias Queta, and the bench rotation is Pritchard, Hauser, Robinson, Walsh and Conley.
Boston is very deep, with at least 12 rotation-level players. In a 10-man rotation, Walsh or another player will miss out most nights.
Both sites price him at 0 USD and rank him well outside the 144 players drafted in our league. He is not a draft target for us.

durable.text: He is a player with limited offense. Boston gets a lot out of players like him.
Points are his weakest category and fall far below the top 250 pool.

note: Jordan Walsh is not a draft pick in our 12-team auction. Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD, he ranks 298 on Yahoo and 209 on ESPN, and very low scoring (about 5 points per game projected) caps his value. His only small strengths are few turnovers and average FG% and blocks for a forward. Early in the season, check whether he stays in Boston's crowded 10-man rotation and gets close to ESPN's projected 21.5 minutes. Only an injury to Tatum or George would make him worth a waiver claim.
